summary:
Implementation plan for:
1. Recharts-powered monthly fee revenue collection vs budget analytical dashboard in FeeManagementSuite.
2. Automated and manual Email/SMS overdue fee reminder notification trigger engine integrated with SystemSecurityConsole rule engine.
3. Comprehensive Student Management Suite extension with Add, Edit, Bulk Import/Export, Status Tracking (Active, Suspended, Banned), and student-level CO/PO attainment & CGPA tracking.
4. Dedicated Academics & Curriculum Hub with Program Timetable, Syllabus Coverage Tracker, CO-PO Attainment Matrix with automated calculation, Lesson Plans, and Faculty Teacher's Diary.
